crossRefs.note: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to…
Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and…
So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from…
To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go…
Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and…
You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were…
He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and…
They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely, when I have…
“ ‘ “I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I won’t allow my holy name to be profaned any more. Then…
“Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy on the whole house of…
Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the…
For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches…
whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave; all of them slain, fallen…
“There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by…
They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons…
“For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain…
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

translations.web: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
translations.bsb: then I will bring you down with those who descend to the Pit, to the people of antiquity. I will make you dwell in the earth below like the ancient ruins, with those who descend to the Pit, so that you will no longer be inhabited or set in splendor in the land of the living.
translations.kjv: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
translations.asv: then will I bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make thee to dwell in the nether parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living:
